name: Swed Saw
description: High-gain Swedish chainsaw distortion with dual-band resonant mid/high gyrator EQ.

params.name: Dist
params.explanation: Cascaded dual-stage chainsaw clipping gain (0..100; dime it for Swedish buzz!).

params.name: Col L
params.explanation: HM-2 ~90 Hz active gyrator low punch (50 = neutral, 100 = dimed wall).

params.name: Col H
params.explanation: HM-2 ~1.15 kHz + ~3.0 kHz active gyrator chainsaw snarl (50 = neutral, 100 = full buzz).

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Parallel dry/wet blend (100 = pure chainsaw, 65-85 keeps vocals razor-clear).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Output level (80 is unity at nominal MS-70CDR+ bus level).
